privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: How Mahdu Rahmah uses the details you send through this website.
privacy.collectAdmission: the child's name, date of birth and class applied for; the parent or guardian's name, phone number and email address; and, if you choose to give them, the previous school, home address and a message. We use these only to consider the application and to contact the family about it.
privacy.collectContact: your name, email address, optional phone number and your message. We use them only to reply to you.
privacy.whoText: Only the school's administrators. Applications and messages are never shown on the public website, and they are not sold or shared for advertising.
privacy.paymentsText: Fees are paid on Paystack's own page. The school never sees or stores card details.
privacy.rightsText: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 you can ask the school what it holds about you or your child, ask for mistakes to be corrected, and ask for details to be deleted where the law allows. Contact the school using the details on the
